thag6.13:1.1: Channam ativassati, vivaṭaṃ nātivassati: tasmā channaṃ vivaretha, evan taṃ nātivassati. || ||
thag6.13:2.1: maccun' abbhāhato loko, jarāya parivārito, taṇhāsallena otiṇṇo, icchādhūpāyito sadā. || ||
thag6.13:3.1: maccun' abbhāhato loko parikkhitto jarāya ca, haññati niccam attāṇo pattadaṇḍo va takkaro. || ||
thag6.13:4.1: āgacchant' aggikhandhā va maccubyādhijarā tayo, paccuggantuṃ balaṃ n' atthi, javo n' atthi palāyituṃ. || ||
thag6.13:5.1: amoghaṃ divasaṃ kayirā appena bahukena vā; yaṃ yaṃ vijahate rattiṃ tadūnan tassa jīvitaṃ. || ||
thag6.13:6.1: carato tiṭṭhato vāpi āsīnasayanassa vā upeti carimā ratti, na te kālo pamajjitun ti. || || Sirimaṇḍo thero.
